verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a single-URL scrape that turns a page into parseable text. It also claims agentic multi-page extraction in a single request, such as finding every dental practice and pulling every dentist from each one, which implies traversing many pages. However, no crawl endpoint is documented that walks an entire site and returns the content of all its pages. Missing for 10: a documented site-crawl capability (whole-site traversal from a root URL), full page content returned for every crawled page, crawl limits and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
